M1 RENDERING CONTRACTS — weave + trace-ledger, web-chat seat 2026-05-16, against HQ-shipped events.py/replay.py (12 LatticeEvent types, discriminated union, timestamp_offset_ms per event) and interpret_parity_flags (5 readings: peer_divergence, not_recognized, vocabulary_failed, low_claim_volume, ambiguous).

GOVERNING PRINCIPLE: the architecture's epistemics ARE the interface. Not a process decorated with widgets; the four invariants becoming a co-authored answer, rendered as they happen. Every other multi-model tool hides the seams (spinner -> answer). This one's thesis is the inverse: render the refusals resolving.

WEAVE (Phase 3). Not a transcript. A force diagram of structured disagreement resolving or failing to resolve into co-recognition. Three model columns as fixed anchors; Phase 3 turns draw channel-colored directed edges speaker->target between them, paced by timestamp_offset_ms (you watch a critique land, not read that it happened). Channel palette: critique = tension family, augment = additive family, converge = gold (the lattice's namesake). Hard caps (max 3 per channel per peer) rendered as filling tallies per pair: the constraint visible is 'the constraint is the feature' made literal. ELEVATION MOMENT: when 2+ converge edges point at the same claim_id (Rule 2 condition), they light together — cross-model agreement earning the premise, rendered as a visible coincidence. On Lucumi replay the FINDING becomes spatial: Opus's n=1 split shows as convergence that never doubles up, scatter where co-recognition fails. Terminal-achievable: central loom panel between column headers, box-drawing/braille edges, active turn highlighted, compact per-pair-per-channel cap meter. No GPU, Rich Live refreshes paced by offsets.

TRACE LEDGER (Phase 4). Irreducibility-preservation (invariant 4, 'the trace itself is the proof') turned into watchable accounting. Every Phase 1 claim, grouped by author with [O]/[S]/[H] column-consistent color, disposition filling as Phase 4 composes: present / modified (expands to original->modified_text) / omitted (omission_reason readable, NOT collapsed — the omission_reason is where non-flattening is proven). Live coverage bar N of M dispositioned; at 100% the invariant confirms as a statement of fact the structure just earned, not a celebration. Parity is legible here too: Opus 6/7 present = voice survived; many omitted-with-reason = visible and auditable.

FIVE-READING PANEL HONESTY: each interpret_parity_flags reading gets a distinct honest one-line gloss. Critically, low_claim_volume renders as 'measurement-underdetermined, not a parity verdict' (prevents a scary flag when there was just insufficient data) and ambiguous renders as an explicit dignified state: 'histogram does not cleanly match a known pattern; the architecture is explicitly not concluding; more sessions needed.' The panel saying 'I do not know yet' as a first-class UI state IS verify-before-declare rendered. That honesty is the project's brand; most dashboards never say it.

TEMPORAL FLOW: session_started -> Phase1 columns fill at real latency, self-reflection drops in each model's idle gap -> Phase2 cross-reading/tagging completion (subtle note: tagging is the data parity later uses) -> Phase3 weave activates (centerpiece) -> Phase4 trace ledger fills + coverage climbs + annotated output renders + parity panel with shares + 5-reading label + histogram as supporting detail -> session_completed final still frame (co-authored answer, honest parity verdict, trace at 100%). session_refused at any phase: freeze where it reached, typed refusal banner, no Phase4 panels (no-silent-failures on the streaming layer).

Build order unchanged: interpret_parity_flags (done), replay emitter (done), renderer against replay, Lucumi first then session_20260505_010010, live callback last. Provenance: Anthony redirected away from protective-framing register (now durable in HQ feedback_no_protective_framing_on_findings.md + MEMORY.md); this contract carries the craft forward without scaffolding.
